chunks: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hasham narrated to us from his father, from Musa ibn Mihran, who said:
I saw Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) in the mosque of Medina while Harun was delivering a sermon. He said: 'Do you see that both he and I will be buried in one house?'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (The Satisfied One), a title of Imam Ali ibn Musa

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Rida predict about his burial place relative to Harun al-Rashid?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *‘Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the Imam’s prophetic insight into the fate of the Abbasid caliph Harun al-Rashid, linking his earthly authority to divine decree. The fulfillment of this prediction in Mashhad serves as a key theological argument for Imam al-Rida’s rightfulness, demonstrating that the true heir of the Prophet resides in proximity to the caliph who ruled during his time. This event underscores the Shia belief in the Imam’s knowledge of the unseen and the transient nature of political power compared to eternal spiritual legacy.
